description: METADATA-FORGE-RETRY (docs/operations/aws-revisao-arquitetura.md, finding 22): seconds of pauses the gate may spend trying `pr metadata` again while its only refusals are the forge not answering the read of the PR (gate-infra.call_retries bounds the count, gate-infra.call_backoff_s the pauses). On 11/11 03:04 UTC the forge answered 503 for about three minutes and a delivery was red at `pr metadata` with nothing wrong in its PR; a delivery judged again costs six minutes or more, so waiting five for the forge is the cheaper side. Past it the stage is red, by name: the forge did not answer.
